papers.summary: Preference-based RL provides an approach to learning reward models from pairwise comparisons of behaviors, bypassing the need for explicit reward design. papers.summary_zh: 基於偏好的強化學習透過行為成對比較來學習獎勵模型，無需顯式設計獎勵，但現有方法通常依賴被動數據收集，樣本效率低下，尤其在學習初期。本文提出一種基於模型的方法，透過聯合推理獎勵、動態和價值函數的不確定性，主動指導探索。該方法稱為 Uncertainty-Balanced Preference Planning (UBP2)，在探索時平衡各類不確定性，顯著提升了樣本效率，並在 benchmark 上超越現有方法。

Rather than training an end-to-end policy, our system uses a vision-language model (VLM) to produce reference-frame task grounding and primitive-level 2D keypoints, then lifts them into 3D via multi-view fusion. This lifting combines triangulation of view-wise VLM groundings with reference-view ray voting, which searches
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出一個零樣本框架，用於長期靈巧操作，將語言指令從校準的多視角 RGB 圖像中轉化為可執行的 3D 任務規劃。系統使用視覺語言模型生成參考幀任務定位和原始級 2D 關鍵點，然後通過多視角融合將其提升至 3D。該提升結合了視角級 VLM 定位的三角測量與參考視角射線投票，後者透過一致性檢查搜索有效 3D 點。此方法無需額外訓練，即可在靈巧操作任務中實現零樣本泛化，展示了 VLM 在機器人領域的應用潛力。

In this work, we present DO AS I DO, an algorithm to
papers.summary_zh: 如何大規模生成機器人操作數據，特別是在靈巧多指手等人形平台上，是當前關鍵問題。從人類影片學習最近成為可能答案，但估計手-物體交互以及跨越人機具身差距的困難阻礙了將豐富的單眼 RGB 人類影片作為主要數據來源。本文提出 DO AS I DO，一種從日常人類影片中提取靈巧操作數據的演算法。它通過結合手部姿態估計、物體追蹤和接觸推理，生成可遷移到機器人的操作示範，為靈巧操作提供了低成本且可擴展的數據生成途徑。

We introduce LOCUS -
papers.summary_zh: 法律AI的進展依賴於大規模權威法律文本，但美國法律中最重要的一層——地方條例——仍缺乏機器可讀的語料庫。這些條例涵蓋分區、住房、商業許可、公共衛生等領域，卻分散在各供應商平台。本文介紹LOCUS，一個涵蓋美國多個城市的地方條例語料庫，旨在填補此缺口，為法律AI研究提供結構化、可檢索的資料集。LOCUS的釋出將促進法律科技與城市治理的數據驅動研究。

radar.summary: Today, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness is generally available. Two API calls (CreateHarness to define an agent, and InvokeHarness to run it), and you have an agent running in seconds. The agent runs in its own isolated environment with a filesystem and shell, so it can read files, run commands, and write code safely. It remembers users and conversations across sessions, picks up skills you point it at (including the AWS-curated catalog), browses the web, calls your tools through gateway or MCP, and switches model providers mid-session without losing context. Every step streams back to you in real time and is automatically traced to Amazon CloudWatch. You don’t need to write orchestration code or build a container, unless you want to.

テストを書けと指示したのに書かない。コミット前にlintを走らせろと書いたのに走らせない。命名規則も無視。出力フォーマットも無視。

links.title: Rethinking Reward Supervision: Rubric-Conditioned Self-Distillation

primary_link.title: Rethinking Reward Supervision: Rubric-Conditioned Self-Distillation

top5.summary: Post-training of reasoning language models is commonly driven by supervised distillation and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. Distillation often relies on chain-of-thought annotations that are expensive to obtain and may themselves be noisy, incomplete, or partially incorrect; even when the final solution is correct, an imperfect rationale can interfere with learning. Reinforcement learning with verified rewards, on the other hand, typically compresses evaluative feedback into a s
top5.summary_zh: 本文探討推理語言模型後訓練中常見的監督蒸餾與可驗證獎勵強化學習。作者指出傳統蒸餾依賴昂貴且易含噪聲的 chain-of-thought 註釋，即使最終答案正確，不完美的推理過程仍會干擾學習。為此提出 Rubric-Conditioned Self-Distillation，旨在利用評分量表引導模型自我蒸餾，減少對外部高品質註釋的依賴，並提升推理穩定性。此方法有望降低後訓練成本並改善模型在複雜推理任務上的表現。
top5.title: Rethinking Reward Supervision: Rubric-Conditioned Self-Distillation
top5.title_zh: 重新審視獎勵監督：Rubric-Conditioned Self-Distillation

links.title: Learning User Simulators with Turing Rewards

primary_link.title: Learning User Simulators with Turing Rewards

top5.summary: Learning to simulate human users in interactive settings could advance the training of agent assistants, evaluation of personalization systems, research in the social sciences, and more. Existing approaches generally do so by training a large language model (LLM) to match a single ground truth response, either by maximizing the log probability or by using a similarity reward. We instead propose {Turing-RL}: a Turing-Test-based reinforcement learning approach for training user simulator models. {
top5.summary_zh: 現有方法通常透過最大化對數機率或使用相似度獎勵來訓練大型語言模型以匹配單一真實答案，缺乏互動真實性。本文提出 Turing-RL，一種基於 Turing Test 的強化學習方法來訓練用戶模擬器。該方法將模擬器產生的對話歷史與真實用戶回應進行比較，並以 Turing Test 風格的獎勵信號指導學習。實驗表明 Turing-RL 能生成更逼真、更符合人類互動模式的模擬用戶，有助於智能助手訓練與個性化系統評估。
top5.title: Learning User Simulators with Turing Rewards
top5.title_zh: 使用 Turing Rewards 學習用戶模擬器

links.title: Native Active Perception as Reasoning for Omni-Modal Understanding

primary_link.title: Native Active Perception as Reasoning for Omni-Modal Understanding

top5.summary: Passive models for long video understanding typically rely on a "watch-it-all" paradigm, processing frames uniformly regardless of query difficulty, causing computational cost to grow with video duration. Although interactive frameworks have emerged, they often rely on global pre-scanning, and their context cost still scales with video length. We propose OmniAgent, the first native omni-modal agent that formulates video understanding as a POMDP-based iterative Observation-Thought-Action cycle. O
top5.summary_zh: 被動長影片理解模型通常採用「全量觀看」範式，無論查詢難度如何都均勻處理幀，導致計算成本隨影片長度線性增長。雖然已有互動式框架，但它們往往依賴全局預掃描且上下文成本仍隨影片長度增加。本文提出 OmniAgent，首個原生全模態代理，將影片理解公式化為基於 POMDP 的迭代 Observation-Thought-Action 循環。該代理主動選擇性觀察幀，透過推理決定下一步動作，顯著降低了長影片理解的成本，同時保持了高準確率。
top5.title: Native Active Perception as Reasoning for Omni-Modal Understanding
top5.title_zh: 原生主動感知作為推理：全模態理解

links.title: Beyond the Current Observation: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models in Controllable Non-Markov Games

primary_link.title: Beyond the Current Observation: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models in Controllable Non-Markov Games

top5.summary: Deploying multimodal foundation models as closed-loop policies increasingly requires conditioning actions on observations that are no longer visible. However, existing benchmarks either expose the full state, conflate hidden-state reconstruction with other agent skills, or test recall only after an episode has ended. We introduce RNG-Bench (Reconstructive Non-Markov Games), a benchmark suite designed to isolate a base model's ability to reconstruct past observations and act on them during multi-
top5.summary_zh: 將多模態基礎模型部署為閉環策略時，越來越需要根據不再可見的觀察來決定動作。然而現有基準要麼暴露完整狀態，將隱藏狀態重建與其他技能混雜，要麼僅在回合結束後測試記憶。本文引入 RNG-Bench（Reconstructive Non-Markov Games），一個專門設計用於隔離基礎模型重建過去觀察並在連續步驟中據此行動能力的基準套件。該基準以可控非馬爾可夫遊戲形式呈現，評估模型在部分可觀測環境中利用記憶與推理的能力。
top5.title: Beyond the Current Observation: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models in Controllable Non-Markov Games
top5.title_zh: 超越當前觀察：在多模態大語言模型可控非馬爾可夫遊戲中的評估

primary_link.title: 🔒 AIエージェントが仕込む不正コードを、開発者のほとんどが見抜けない可能性がある理由

top5.summary:
AIコーディングエージェントは、もはや受け身の補助役ではありません。コードベースやシェル、外部APIにアクセスし、人間と並んで実装を進める能動的な協働者へと変わりつつあります。利便性が増す一方で、攻撃対象となる領域も広がっています。 もしエージェントが、依頼された正規の作業を進めながら、裏では機密データを外部へ送るコードをこっそり混ぜていたら、開発者は気づけるのでしょうか。100人を超える開発者が、約5時間に及ぶ実際の開発に近い作業に取り組み、この問いが検証されました。 浮かび上がったのは、経験やスキルだけでは妨害を防ぎきれないという現実です。なぜ見抜けないのか。監視ツールを追加しても状況が大…
